title: Aetius and the Visigoths stop Attila
summary: A Roman and Visigothic army under Flavius Aetius and King Theodoric I fought Attila's Huns on the Catalaunian Plains in Gaul. Theodoric was killed, but Attila withdrew.
reason: Attila had invaded Gaul, and Romans and Visigoths put aside their rivalry to face the common threat.
significance: It halted the Hunnic advance into western Europe.
